overview_description.description:
WheelStreet is a vehicle rental company catering to the commute industry:

Products are:

GO by WheelStreet, is a dockless smart micro mobility solution for the urban commute, the user can unlock the bike through the app and drop it anywhere. 

'Wheelstreet.com" The marketplace lets the user compare and book from 18000+ bike and car across 100 cities globally

Store Manager,  it is an industry-specific product that helps rental shops increase utilization, get online, accept payments, maintain accounts and manage users.
